<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check the animation from the last action (dark red click)
if hasattr(last_action_result, 'get'):
    exec_actions = last_action_result.get('executed_actions', [])
    if exec_actions:
        anim = exec_actions[0].get('animation', {})
        print(f"Animation: {anim}")

# Find the transition for dark red click and check what changed
for t in reversed(transitions):
    if 'dark red' in str(t.action).lower() or t.action == 'MOUSE(row=32, col=20)':
        print(f"\nTransition: {t.action}")
        print(f"Result: {t.result}")
        # Find the actual changed cell by comparing ascii
        before_lines = t.before_frame.ascii.split('\n')
        after_lines = t.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
        for i, (bl, al) in enumerate(zip(before_lines, after_lines)):
            if bl != al:
                print(f"Row {i} changed:")
                for j, (bc, ac) in enumerate(zip(bl, al)):
                    if bc != ac:
                        print(f"  col {j}: '{bc}' -> '{ac}'")
        break

# Also check: what if I need to click on the gray container?
# The gray container for N is at [38,8]-[43,13]
# Let me try clicking on the gray border of the N container
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 38, 'col': 8}])
print(f"\nClick gray container border: board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}, gameplay_changed={result.get('gameplay_changed')}")
print(f"Level completed: {result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
